content: We’re proud to share that we are strengthening our collaboration withHTX (Home Team Science & Technology Agency), driving innovation in AI for Security and Safety.Together, we will explore new research opportunities:🦾 Embodied AI: new understanding abilities for robots, autonomous navigation in unmapped environments, objects retrieval🧯 Fire safety: automated building mapping, safety reviews🛡️ Cybersecurity: vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, compliance reviewsThis project proves that custom models are key to solving complex real-world challenges. It also marks a new step in our expansion across Singapore and APAC.Stay tuned for updates!

We’re happy to share that we are taking our partnership withSAPto the next level as we will deliver sovereign AI products together, accelerating Europe’s digital transformation.Mistral AI’s cutting-edge solutions combined with SAP’s platform will ensure that European public services and businesses can innovate without sacrificing control over their data or infrastructure. Starting today, we will:🇪🇺 Build and deliver a fully sovereign AI stack for Europe⚡️ Integrate our models, our AI studio, and Le Chat into SAP’s AI Foundation🏭 Co-develop and co-sell vertical AI products for industries and public servicesThe future of AI in Europe is being built today.Stay tuned for what’s next!

Building Intelligent Document Solutions with Mistral AI ( With Code )Documents are the hidden bottleneck in every enterprise.Contracts buried in PDFs, invoices lost in email chains, and reports gathering dust in shared drives. Mistral Document AI doesn’t just read files; it understands them, turning static text into structured data that powers workflows, triggers actions, and eliminates manual grunt work.During this course, you’ll learn how to leverage our Document AI solution with code !

Building Custom MCP Servers for Le ChatJoin the Mistral team for an exclusive deep dive into Le Chat’s MCP capabilities! In this session, you’ll discover how to:- Design your MCP server.- Explore deployment options for your MCP server.- Integrate your custom MCP directly into Le Chat.This is your chance to unlock the potential of MCP and learn how it empowers the creation of private, personalized AI experiences for businesses and consumers alike.We can’t wait to see you at the webinar!

Meet the new Codestral 25.08 and the complete Mistral Coding Stack for Enterprises!Our full-stack approach is designed to support enterprise-grade software development across every stage—from code suggestion to autonomous pull requests. Here's what we offer:1️⃣ Codestral 25.08: our latest update excels at prioritizing the most helpful suggestions, reducing distractions to let you focus on what matters. It delivers a +30% increase in accepted completions, +10% more retained code after suggestion, and 50% fewer runaway generations.2️⃣ Codestral Embed: experience high-recall, low-latency search across massive codebases with our advanced embedding model.3️⃣ Devstral: autonomous multi-step development with agentic workflows, powered by the OpenHands agent scaffold.4️⃣ Mistral Code: our native plugin for JetBrains and VS Code provides inline completions, complex task automations, and integrated semantic search.The full Mistral coding stack is available today for enterprise deployment.For more information and to get started today:https://lnkd.in/esecSsrV

We are thrilled to announce Magistral, our first reasoning model designed to excel in domain-specific, transparent, and multilingual reasoning. 🌍🤖🔄 Two variants: Magistral Small (24B parameter open-source version) and Magistral Medium (enterprise version).🔍 Enhanced reasoning: Fine-tuned for multi-step logic, improving interpretability and providing a traceable thought process.🌐 Multilingual dexterity: Excels in reasoning across numerous languages including English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Russian, and Simplified Chinese.⚡ Runtime speed at scale: Up to 10x faster token throughput with Flash Answers on Le Chat.🛠️ Versatility in Application: Ideal for business strategy, regulated industries, systems engineering, and content creation.Download Magistral Small from:https://lnkd.in/gJeSMAei. Try out Magistral Medium inhttps://chat.mistral.ai/or via API onhttp://console.mistral.ai/. For enterprise and custom solutions, contact us at:https://mistral.ai/contact.For more details, check out our blog post:https://lnkd.in/gtd2UHFv

Proud to announce the creation of Europe’s largest AI Campus, located in the Paris region, a groundbreaking joint-venture withMGX,NVIDIA, andBpifrance.🇪🇺 This initiative marks a pivotal step toward building sovereign, sustainable, and globally competitive AI infrastructure in Europe.⚙️ The campus will support the entire AI lifecycle - from model training and inference to real-world deployment in critical sectors like healthcare, energy, mobility, finance, and manufacturing.⚡ It will be powered by an ecosystem of public and private partners, includingGroupe Bouygues,法國巴黎綜合理工學院,RTE Réseau de Transport d'Electricité, andSipartech.🏗️ Construction kicks off this year, with the campus set to be fully operational by the end of 2027.We are proud to contribute to this transformative journey and to help shape the future of AI in France and Europe.—Nous sommes fiers d'annoncer la création du plus grand Campus IA d'Europe, situé en région parisienne, grâce à un partenariat inédit avecMGX,NVIDIA, etBpifrance.🇪🇺 Cette initiative marque une étape décisive vers la construction d'une infrastructure souveraine, durable et compétitive pour l’IA en Europe.⚙️ Le Campus IA soutiendra l'ensemble du cycle de vie de l'IA - de l’entraînement et l'inférence des modèles à leur déploiement dans des secteurs critiques tels que la santé, l'énergie, la mobilité, la finance et la fabrication.⚡ Il sera alimenté par un écosystème de partenaires publics et privés, incluantGroupe Bouygues,法國巴黎綜合理工學院,RTEetSipartech.🏗️ La construction démarre cette année, pour un démarrage d'ici la fin de 2027.Nous sommes fiers de contribuer à ce projet ambitieux et de contribuer à façonner l'avenir de l'IA en France et en Europe.

Tomorrow kicks off the AI Action Summit, and we’ve got some big news to share: we’re thrilled to announce our very first AI cluster!💡 It’s a state-of-the-art facility that will foster our growth and R&D efforts.🇫🇷 It will be located near our home base in the Paris Region, in Essonne, France.⚡ This scalable data center will be equipped with the latest chips to run our models, and fully powered by decarbonized energy.⏱️ It will be up and running in the next months.This marks another big step in strengthening our independence, as we continue to make AI more accessible with high-performance, customizable, and open-source AI solutions for all!More information here:https://lnkd.in/epkzxAdV---A la veille de l'AI Action Summit, nous sommes ravis d'annoncer notre tout premier cluster AI !💡 Ce centre de données de pointe favorisera notre croissance et notre R&D.🇫🇷 Il sera situé près de Paris, dans l'Essonne.⚡ Il sera équipé des dernières puces pour entraîner nos modèles et sera alimenté par une énergie décarbonée.⏱️ Il sera opérationnel dans les mois à venir.Il s’agit d’une nouvelle étape décisive pour notre développement et notre indépendance et qui nous permettra de continuer de rendre l'IA toujours plus accessible, plus personnalisable et open-source pour tous !

We are thrilled to share our latest blog post from the Solutions team, showcasing how we apply Mistral technology to tackle complex business challenges.Fine-tuning foundation models is revolutionizing the way we approach real-world AI applications. By adapting pre-trained models to specific domains, we can achieve dramatically better performance on specialized tasks.In this blog post, we demonstrate how you can apply LoRA fine-tuning to a Pixtral-12B model directly within the Mistral ecosystem. Using satellite imagery, we show how this technique can lead to significant improvements on an image recognition task, highlighting the power of domain-specific adaptation.https://lnkd.in/gFURuAXXInterested in more custom work with the Mistral AI team? Contact us for solution support and discover how we can help you achieve your AI goals.https://mistral.ai/contact

Introducing Mistral Saba, our first regional language model, designed to excel in Arabic and South Indian-origin languages such as Tamil.As AI adoption grows worldwide, it is crucial to have models that aren’t just fluent, but truly native - understanding local linguistic nuances, cultural context, and regional knowledge.Mistral Saba is a 24B parameter model that has been trained on meticulously curated datasets from across the Middle East and South Asia.
